stories.title: The Little Cat
stories.teaser: Many hundreds of years ago, the Pestleutchen once brought the Great Death from foreign lands into the mountains of Valais.

image.alt: A man opens an Alpine hut window to a small cat on the sill, with mountains beyond.

stories.title: Cats Are Merry
stories.teaser: Once, late in the evening, a man passed a house that had long stood empty. Suddenly he heard noise inside, went to the little shutter, looked in, and saw a heap of cats upon the stove. Their Maudi was there as well.

image.alt: A man peers through a farmhouse shutter at cats gathered on a masonry stove.

stories.title: A Cold Bedfellow
stories.teaser: Two men from Gurtnellen—I could give you their names and families—once went crystal hunting in the Fellital.

image.alt: Two crystal hunters lie awake on hay beside a pale, still figure in a dark barn.

stories.title: Witches, Bells, and a Monastery Fire
stories.teaser: In the autumn month of 1737, one of central Switzerland’s most detested evildoers, Lisi Bossard, died by fire in Zug after agonizing suffering.

image.alt: A woman points toward a burning monastery as men pull ropes to ring the bells.

stories.title: The Witch Maidens of Habkeren
stories.teaser: Long ago—no one knows how long—two boys from Habkeren used to visit two maidens about whom the people could not say who they were or where they had come from into the mountain valley.

image.alt: Two young men study a book at a crowded feast among richly dressed women.

stories.title: A Priest Abducted to the Witches' Dance
stories.teaser: In the time of Maximilian the First, an exceedingly devout and God-fearing priest lived in the Rhaetian Alps.

image.alt: A kneeling priest faces a seated woman while dancers gather in a wooded mountain clearing.

stories.title: Ghostly Village Animals
stories.teaser: A local description from the region of Lake Hallwil gives the following account:

image.alt: Pale animal shapes whirl around a boulder above a wooded valley.

stories.title: Ghosts (Dialect)
stories.teaser: In Rapperswil, beside the Chilchä, there is a Beihuus in which a whole pile of Toutächöpf lies one atop another.

image.alt: Villagers watch a man reach for a skull in an open charnel-house cupboard.

stories.title: A Nocturnal Specter and Ghostly Night Music in Lucerne
stories.teaser: In the year 1607, during the summer at night, a wondrous and terrifying specter allowed itself to be seen several times in the city of Lucerne.

image.alt: Moonlit figures stream past two onlookers beside Lucerne’s covered bridge.

stories.title: A Witch Flies Out as a Bumblebee
stories.teaser: A woman once lived in a village in the canton of Glarus. This woman was a witch. For a long time, no one knew it, but at last it was revealed in the following way.

image.alt: A man watches a motionless woman in bed as a bumblebee flies through the open window.

stories.title: The Haunting Cat — Hägglingen
stories.teaser: People in Hägglingen in the Freiamt had learned from a sorcerer what means could be used to reach a treasure whose existence had long been spoken of in that village.

image.alt: Men dig beneath a tree by moonlight beside a pole topped with a cat’s head.

stories.title: The Haunted House
stories.teaser: In a suburb of Basel stands a large old house that may well be many hundreds of years old.

image.alt: Three women and a cleric recoil from a pale apparition above a farmhouse hearth.

stories.title: The Musical Ghost in Menzingen
stories.teaser: In the year 17.., the wife of Nepomuk Landis of Menzingen went on pilgrimage to Maria Einsiedeln with her child, a twelve-year-old girl.

image.alt: A woman looks from a flower-framed window toward a pale figure on the village path.

stories.title: A Witch’s Revenge
stories.teaser: In ancient times a farmer lived in Ems; he was called “Gschworne Christof.” He had a maidservant from the Oberland.

image.alt: A woman points across a hay barn while a man watches from behind a timber post.

stories.title: Ghost Story from the Hanig
stories.teaser: Once a man from Eisten who wished to visit his sweetheart in Grächen was overtaken by night on the Hanig Alp.

image.alt: A man flees a fiery apparition on a mountain path beside a wayside cross.

stories.title: The Night Ghost of Plaffeien, the Gassentätscher
stories.teaser: In former times, a horrible night ghost haunted the streets and side roads around Plaffeien, but chiefly the place itself.

image.alt: Villagers shrink back from a glowing red, doglike creature beside a village fountain.

stories.title: The Outwitted Witch
stories.teaser: The wife of a councillor in Ennetbürgen near Stans was also one of those who loved the Black One more than her wedded husband.

image.alt: A man ties a seated woman to a horse cart loaded with firewood.

stories.title: An Adventure with a Ghost
stories.teaser: Our father († 1923, 84 years old)—he often told this story—was looking out for the neighbor's kids one evening and was standing at the Riggäport at Gufern in the Maderanertal.

image.alt: A traveler draws back a blanket to reveal two pale impressions on an empty bed.

stories.title: The Punished Witch (St. Gallen)
stories.teaser: A blacksmith’s nighttime suffering leads to the discovery of a woman bearing the marks of horseshoes.

image.alt: Two men shoe a white horse at a forge beneath a moonlit mountain sky.

stories.title: Hunting Grounds of the Wild Hunt around Aarau
stories.teaser: On the right bank of the Aare, the hunting din begins in the Aarau Oberholz; one hears the cry “Aho” and the blowing of a horn.

image.alt: A mounted spectral hunter and hounds rush through a moonlit forest above a startled traveler.

stories.title: The Spectral Alpine Herdsmen (Bern)
stories.teaser: A chamois hunter shelters in an alpine hut and encounters the spectral dairy workers who occupy it.

image.alt: A young man offers a bowl to a seated Alpine herdsman beside a hut hearth.

stories.title: The Serpent Maiden (Basel)
stories.teaser: Leonhard enters an underground passage in Basel and meets a serpent maiden whose release depends on his conduct.

image.alt: A crowned serpent maiden offers a coin to a kneeling man beside a treasure chest.

stories.title: Bewitched Livestock
stories.teaser: The widow B ...... in Fläsch shared a stable with a neighbor whose wife was a witch.

image.alt: A man and woman stare at pigs rearing upright inside a farm building.

stories.title: The Deceived Haunter
stories.teaser: West of the Sanetsch valley, high on a mountain plateau rich in fodder, lies the beautiful Gundis Alp called Pointet.

image.alt: A traveler with a sword approaches a horned hide draped over a boulder on a mountain path.

stories.title: The Ghost on the Gisikon Bridge
stories.teaser: Formerly, before the federal campaign of 1847—the Sonderbund War—an image of the Holy Trinity stood in the middle of the Gisikon Bridge.

image.alt: A traveler recoils from a large shaggy dog sprawled across a moonlit bridge.

stories.title: The Haunting Priest near St. Wendel
stories.teaser: Near St. Wendel, on the far side of the Linth, there once stood a chapel of which scarcely even ruins can now be seen.

image.alt: The pale figure of a priest walks above a grassy churchyard among old stone walls.

stories.title: Finger Wrestling with a Ghost (Maderanertal)
stories.teaser: A Maderanertal storyteller turns an old encounter with a ghost into an adventure he claims as his own.

image.alt: A young man hooks fingers with a hooded apparition beside an Alpine fence.

stories.title: The Witches’ Place near Laupen
stories.teaser: Near the hamlet of Laupen in the municipality of Zuzwil, a round place lies in a small wood, overgrown with marsh grass and a few stunted pines.

image.alt: A mounted traveler points toward a candlelit gathering beneath a forest tree.

stories.title: The Nocturnal Round Table
stories.teaser: At the foot of the Jura, not far from the village of Berolles in the canton of Vaud and a short distance from the so-called Roman road, there is an isolated, round hill of considerable size.

image.alt: Women dance in a circle around a laden table and a white horse beneath a great tree.

stories.title: The Witch Catherine Repond, or Catillon la Toascha
stories.teaser: This witch was actually named Catherine Repond, but when people wanted to anger her, they also called her Catillon la Toascha, or Hunchback Kate.

image.alt: Two women crouch beside a nest on a boulder overlooking a mountain river.

stories.title: The Wild Hunter, or the Thürst
stories.teaser: A farmer and miller in that vicinity once allowed one of his farmhands to go home to his family in the evening.

image.alt: A man peers out of his doorway as a spectral hunt passes along a moonlit mountain road.

stories.title: The Master of Witchcraft
stories.teaser: A wonder-working doctor once lived by the Devil’s Bridge near Einsiedeln in the Canton of Schwyz.

image.alt: A seated man gestures as his young companion reaches into a rushing river with a sword.

stories.title: The Ghost Bed at the Stone Table in the Gönhard
stories.teaser: In one of the corner houses on Kronengasse in Aarau, a notorious usurer died more than half a century ago.

image.alt: A traveler watches a pale seated figure beside a stone table and a bed laid outdoors.

stories.title: The Rider on the White Horse at the Heidenburg
stories.teaser: Heidenburg is the name of a wooded hill on the Breite in the municipality of Bassersdorf in the Canton of Zurich.

image.alt: A cloaked rider urges a white horse along a wooded path in a thunderstorm.

stories.title: Witches Powerless Against Bells
stories.teaser: a) The Chapel of Saint Lawrence at Dallenwil must have stood greatly in the way of a female monster who lived on the alp of Wirzweli, for she swore to destroy it.

image.alt: A woman stretches out her hand toward a village church as rain sweeps across the mountains.

stories.title: Knight Jörg of Jörgenberg
stories.teaser: Knight Jörg of Jörgenberg was a brave warrior, but at the same time the terror of the entire region.

image.alt: A burdened man follows a woman in a red dress away from a castle gateway.

stories.title: The Miracles of the Holy Night
stories.teaser: In Valais, people are also said once to have held it true that on Christmas night, while the clock strikes twelve and for as long as it continues striking, all livestock can speak human language.

image.alt: Two travelers crouch behind rocks as a pale woman sits beside a chest in a snowy moonlit meadow.

stories.title: The Spinner (Vaud)
stories.teaser: A girl in Chesières receives secret help with her spinning from a small wild woman.

image.alt: A woman watches a spinner seated on a donkey outside an Alpine farmhouse.

stories.title: Nidelgret, the Cream Witch
stories.teaser: Not far from Andermatt lies a large white block of stone.

image.alt: Pale figures appear within a great boulder beside a darkening mountain valley.

stories.title: Witches (Eggersriet, SG)
stories.teaser: If one stands a broom upright at the door, witches cannot come in.

image.alt: A woman looks from a farm doorway as an older woman walks away beneath a stormy sky.

stories.title: The Miserly Knight at Castelen
stories.teaser: Not far from Ettiswil in the canton of Lucerne lie the ruins of Castelen Castle.

image.alt: A winged devil embraces a knight among piles of gold inside a ruined castle.

stories.title: The Rosenkranzjungfer near Hägglingen
stories.teaser: Hau is the name of the strip of woods on the right side of the road leading from Hägglingen to Wohlenschwil.

image.alt: A pale woman holding a rosary approaches a seated traveler beneath a wayside cross.

stories.title: The Castle Spirit at Wildenburg
stories.teaser: There are different accounts of how the defiant Wildenburg, enthroned in wild beauty upon a Bühl in the Tobel between the Lorze and the Schwarzenbach near Allenwinden in the canton of Zug, fell.

image.alt: A white spectral horse rises over a rocky gorge below a ruined castle.

stories.title: A Witches’ Dance Place
stories.teaser: Below the Hunzegütsch in the fir forest lies a level clearing that the people call the Häxetanzplatz.

image.alt: Women and a horned figure dance around a woodland fire while other figures fly across the moon.

stories.title: On the Surenen Alps
stories.teaser: On the Surenen Alps between Engelberg and Uri, there is a curious tradition that attributes the mountain pasture's reversion to wilderness to a different sacrilege.

image.alt: A horned beast clashes with a bull as a woman watches from the rocky slope.

stories.title: Three Giant Brothers Play Skittles
stories.teaser: Once, while the young men of Selzach, in Solothurn’s Leberberg district, were playing on their skittles ground, three strange bearded men stepped into their midst and challenged them to a match.

image.alt: Three giant men bowl a great stone ball toward oversized wooden skittles beside a village.

stories.title: The Tailor and His Treasure
stories.teaser: A tailor who liked to parade in velvet and silk, court young women, and be wherever things were especially wild and merry once went across the fields to a baptismal feast.

image.alt: A tailor faces a large black goat beside an open treasure chest in a vaulted chamber.

stories.title: The Little Snow Man
stories.teaser: Lukas Manhart, a herder of many years, relates: ‘On evenings before snowstorms break in during late autumn and force the herders to descend from the Alp with the herd, I often saw a little man in a white cloak who called very strangely but entered nowhere.

image.alt: A traveler and his cow watch a small white figure standing on a rock above an Alpine path.

stories.title: The Aunt as a Witch
stories.teaser: An old man in Ruis in the Oberland related that his father had died when he—the boy—was still small, and that he once asked his mother what had actually been wrong with him.

image.alt: A hunter with a sword confronts a fox rearing upright beside an Alpine farmhouse.

stories.title: The Witch at Hegdorn
stories.teaser: At Hegdorn on the Naters mountain, it is said, there once lived a witch married to an honest man.

image.alt: A man falls backward from a cherry tree as a large black bird drops liquid toward his face.

stories.title: The Old Joggeli Ghost in Sarmenstorf
stories.teaser: When the French invaded Switzerland and plundered the Freiamt, a nun from Fahr Abbey fled to her cousin in Sarmenstorf, a man called old Joggeli.

image.alt: Lantern-bearing travelers recoil from a hooded apparition in a barn doorway.

stories.title: The Witch of Lauterbrunnen
stories.teaser: Many years ago, a woman in Lauterbrunnen was suspected of witchcraft.

image.alt: A man raises a stick at a fallen woman beside a mountain farmhouse.

stories.title: The Ghost at the Watering Trough
stories.teaser: Whenever the farmer at Sigelsbüel (Sigartsbüel 1550) drove his cows to water, they turned in fright and scattered as soon as they approached the trough.

image.alt: A herdsman gestures above a watering trough as cattle plunge away from it.

stories.title: The Drachenried
stories.teaser: In the land of Unterwalden beside Lake Lucerne, a terrible monster dwelled in time beyond memory.

image.alt: A warrior braces a long spear against a fire-breathing dragon on a rocky mountain slope.

stories.title: The Witch and the Grain Field
stories.teaser: A farmer sent his servant several hours away on business.

image.alt: Two men pitch manure from a farm cart outside a stone-and-timber farmhouse.

stories.title: The Ormont Fairy Legend
stories.teaser: In earlier times, the Balmen of the highest cliffs were inhabited by enchantresses and fairies.

image.alt: A young herdsman raises a milking stool toward a dark-haired fairy beside a cave and treasure.

stories.title: The Treasure-Guarding Nun of Schönbrunn
stories.teaser: A convent once stood on the “Chiteboden” below the chapel at Schönbrunn in the canton of Zug. Everything has now vanished, and only a legend has sunk its roots into this ground.

image.alt: A pale veiled nun kneels beside a buried pot as two travelers watch with spades in hand.

stories.title: The Snake Charmer (Jecklin)
stories.teaser: A snake-charmer on the Alp of Schlapin encounters the danger of an unreported white snake.

image.alt: A seated traveler faces a crowned white snake and a gathering of smaller snakes.

stories.title: The Stollenwurm (Fribourg)
stories.teaser: A destructive Stollenwurm haunts the Fantomenloch near Düdingen and is explained as a soul doing penance.

image.alt: Two travelers confront a great coiled serpent in a cave above a mountain stream.

stories.title: The Treasure in the Church at Closters
stories.teaser: From time immemorial, legend has said that much money and treasure lies buried and hidden in the church at Closters.

image.alt: Two men pause with their spades as a pale guardian appears beside buried treasure in an old church.

stories.title: The Witch at the Stafel
stories.teaser: At the time when there was still much talk of witches and Strideln and their mischief, the community of Zermatt held a Gemeintrunk.

image.alt: Two women shelter in an Alpine hut as a dark figure flies over the flock beneath storm clouds.

stories.title: Deliverance from the Venomous Snakes
stories.teaser: A Jewish man who had fled Austria came with his five children to the race of giants at Kalkeisen and asked for protection.

image.alt: Villagers watch a kneeling man draw a white serpent toward a bonfire beside a church.

stories.title: A Woman Teaches Witchcraft
stories.teaser: A little woman wanted to teach a man how to practice witchcraft.

image.alt: A man raises a broom above a woman seated beside a farm doorway.

stories.title: The Unfulfilled Dream (Rochholz)
stories.teaser: Rochholz connects a woman’s treasure dream with Laufenburg’s ruin and the religious obligations of its dead.

image.alt: A woman lifts the lid of a pot of glass shards beside a ruined tower and a black cat.

stories.title: The Ghostly Mass at Saint Jakob
stories.teaser: It was very early in the morning when a devout man from Flüelen—whom the father of my 85-year-old narrator had still known—set out for Altdorf to perform his devotions with the reverend fathers at the Capuchin monastery.

image.alt: A traveler peers into a candlelit church where pale priests celebrate Mass at the altar.

stories.title: The Woman in the Wild Hunt: Schöpferschmied-Anneli
stories.teaser: On the Hostris—that is to say, Hochgesträss, because the ancient road once ran here along the Wigger—lie several Jucharten of farmland called the Holderacker.

image.alt: A mounted woman and spectral hounds rush past a small church above a rocky ravine.

stories.title: The Escherfräulein on the Heidenburg
stories.teaser: A wooded mountain in the municipality of Bassersdorf is called the Heidenburg, and its lower spur the Engelrain.

image.alt: Two travelers flee from a huge toad beneath a tree on a wooded hillside.

stories.title: The Mountain Spirit (Appenzell)
stories.teaser: A mountain spirit appears in mines as a monk-like giant, rewarding some workers and killing others.

image.alt: A hooded mountain spirit pours water into a pail as three herdsmen look on inside a cave.

stories.title: The Ravens of Saint Meinrad
stories.teaser: After the time when Saint Gallus, Saint Fridolin, and Saint Columbanus had converted pagan Switzerland to Christianity with hardship and toil and churches and monasteries were being built everywhere, a God-fearing hermit lived on the…

image.alt: Two intruders threaten a seated monk with sticks while ravens fly around his forest dwelling.

stories.title: The Four Ghostly Sennen and the Chamois Hunter
stories.teaser: A hunter, once overtaken by night while hunting chamois on the Moléson, sought out a Senn hut on the mountainside because it was too late to return home.

image.alt: A hunter sits with four strange Alpine herdsmen around a meal in a mountain hut.

stories.title: The Enchanted Herd-Girl
stories.teaser: On the northern precipice of the Titlis, above the so-called Hochpfad, one can see a rock slab called the Jungfrauenhöhle, of which the following legend is told:

image.alt: A young herdsman approaches a treasure-filled cave guarded by a dragon and an enchanted maiden.

stories.title: The Witch in the Bächen
stories.teaser: Many amusing legends are still told of so-called witches and Strideln: how, for example, they harmed people and made fools of them in many ways, continuing these roguish tricks until at last they had to pay for them at the stake.

image.alt: Three men draw a woman on a wooden sled along an Alpine village path.

stories.title: The Dragon (Pfäfers/SG)
stories.teaser: High above the village of Vättis, in the yellow mountain at an elevation of 2100 meters, there is a grotto, surely one of the most interesting in Switzerland.

image.alt: A dragon flies above a narrow Alpine gorge as villagers watch from a rocky path.

stories.title: The Three Daughters of the Witch Catillon
stories.teaser: According to another legend, Catillon had three pretty daughters who offered a large basket full of eggs for sale at every weekly market in Boll or Fribourg.

image.alt: A boy sits beneath a tree beside a crate of eggs, with a walled town above the river.

stories.title: The Sträggele — Vernaleken (Zug)
stories.teaser: Spinners in Zug tell of a seasonal pursuer who enforces the completion of yarn before Christmas.

image.alt: A wild-haired figure reaches toward a woman leaning out of a farmhouse window.

stories.title: Defending Oneself Against the Doggeli
stories.teaser: One can defend oneself against the Doggeli in many ways. A butcher’s knife is placed beneath the pillow.

image.alt: A woman fastens a looped cord around a bedpost beside a sleeping figure.

stories.title: The Ghostly Shower of Stones
stories.teaser: I was about eight years old and, one evening in Bürglen, was fetching silk bobbins for my two sisters, who wove silk.

image.alt: A young man runs from a shower of stones beside a mountain farmhouse and woodpile.

stories.title: A Bergmännchen Knows of a Treasure
stories.teaser: In Giswil, Canton of Obwalden, a rock called the Giswilerstock rises sheer from an Alp.

image.alt: A traveler looks back toward a glowing opening in the mountainside as a small pale figure appears above it.

stories.title: The Kreuzliberg
stories.teaser: A princess near Baden encounters mountain spirits, and a cross gives the Kreuzliberg its name.

image.alt: A crowned woman raises her arms beside a tree as travelers and a hooded figure watch.

stories.title: The Gold Chain at Jachenhausen
stories.teaser: Near the Zurich village of Jachenhausen on the Pfäffikersee, the well-preserved earthworks of a Roman fort can be seen. A farmer there recently related the following.

image.alt: A man grips a gold chain disappearing into a hole in the earth beside a small blue flame.

stories.title: The Bewitched Girl
stories.teaser: Several people are still alive who knew a small and ugly woman living in the hamlet of St.

image.alt: Villagers hold a young woman beside a village fountain as water splashes around her.

stories.title: The Three Spinners
stories.teaser: In a sunny side valley of the Sihl valley in Schwyz lies the little village of Euthal.

image.alt: Three women with spinning tools sit bound by a cord to a tree while a hooded woman approaches.

stories.title: The Treasure in Rosenburg
stories.teaser: Just as one enters the village of Stans from Stansstad, an old building stands on the right side of the road.

image.alt: A woman with a lantern discovers a golden chest surrounded by candles in a stone vault.

stories.title: Witch Story
stories.teaser: At home in Staldenried, people once held a certain young woman to be a witch who enchanted the livestock.

image.alt: Villagers and a priest gather around a fallen cow while a woman watches from a farmhouse doorway.

stories.title: The Good Dwarfs
stories.teaser: Between Schuoppis and Vögeliberg, a castle stood in ancient times; now only sparse remains, ramparts, walls, and hollows can be found.

image.alt: Small mountain folk offer a cake and dishes of food to villagers beside a rocky Alpine meadow.

stories.title: The Basilisk's Egg
stories.teaser: On the Thursday before Laurentii in the year 1474, on Basel's Kohliberg, where the Freileute lived and the Freiknaben sat in judgment, a rooster was burned together with an egg it had laid.

image.alt: A crowd gathers around a caged rooster and a fire in a walled town square.

stories.title: Of a Witch and Her Toad
stories.teaser: A woman fried little cakes every Sunday, but her husband began shaking his head because he wanted to know how she managed it.

image.alt: A man raises a broom while confronting a woman outside a farmhouse.

stories.title: The Haunting on Gitschenberg
stories.teaser: There, ‘it’ never let people play cards beyond midnight. Once midnight arrived, the playing cards simply vanished, or a ghostly woman laid herself crosswise over the table.

image.alt: Two men watch a pale figure rise above a bed in a moonlit Alpine hut.

stories.title: Brunnenhans on the Giblour in the Canton of Fribourg
stories.teaser: While the Sennen on the Giblour fled into the hut before the storm that had broken loose, one of them, Brunnenhans, was still on the path, bringing up from the valley the provisions ordered long before.

image.alt: A vast spectral bull surges down a rocky mountain torrent beneath thunderclouds.

stories.title: The Erdmännlein in Seeburg's Underground Passage
stories.teaser: Beneath Seeburg Tower, not far from Lucerne, there is an underground passage.

image.alt: Travelers recoil from a fiery hare beside a small bearded guardian and a treasure chest in an underground passage.

stories.title: The Appearance of a Wild Man on Fontanen
stories.teaser: On the Fontanen Alp in the municipality of Giswil stands a little tower built of stone and called the ‘Heathen Tower.’ People claim that the ancient heathens erected it.

image.alt: A man turns toward a shaggy wild man emerging from a stone shelter in the mountains.

stories.title: The Farmer’s Wife as a Witch
stories.teaser: A farmer in Trons owned a Mayensäss called “la Cavrida,” situated in the middle of the forest.

image.alt: A traveler with a drawn sword struggles with a black cat clinging to his shoulder in a barn.

stories.title: The White Chamois (Valais)
stories.teaser: Big Lerjen pursues a white chamois against his priest’s advice and is found dead below an abyss.

image.alt: A hunter watches a white chamois standing above him on a narrow mountain ledge.

stories.title: The Treasure Diggers (J. J. Jakob)
stories.teaser: Every visitor climbing to Grasburg must notice the small horizontal cave entering the southern side of the first building's wall.

image.alt: Three men peer into a glowing treasure-filled cave beneath an old stone wall.

stories.title: The Water Man at Staffelbach
stories.teaser: A churchgoer sees a farmer working in the irrigation ditches and then sees him inside the church. The congregation insists the man was there the whole morning.

image.alt: A traveler watches a man dig beside a river below the windows of a village house.

stories.title: The Money Treasure at Freudenberg
stories.teaser: Underground passages are said to have led from one of the towers to Wartenstein Castle and beneath the Rhine to Brandis Castle in Maienfeld.

image.alt: A great black dog guards a treasure chest beside a coiled snake in a ruined castle.

stories.title: The Crowned Snake of Niederlenz
stories.teaser: Southwest of the village of Niederlenz, in the level grain fields, lies a charming hill richly overgrown with tall grass and planted with many cherry and apple trees.

image.alt: A traveler kneels before a crowned white snake holding a ring of keys beneath a blossoming tree.

stories.title: The Abducted Child (Brig)
stories.teaser: A child missing from Brig is found high above the valley after an uncanny journey.

image.alt: A woman reaches toward a disheveled child as two men look on beside an Alpine cave.

stories.title: The Treasure in the Blumalp
stories.teaser: Once there lived a poor man.

image.alt: A man sprinkles water over a golden skull among other skulls on a charnel-house shelf.
